edges.label: KONA BLUE was proposed by AAWSAP's contractor team after DIA cancelled the program
edges.note: AARO records that when DIA cancelled AAWSAP/AATIP its supporters proposed a new version to DHS under a special access program, with lines of effort closely mirroring those the private sector organisation had conducted.
